critical_steps: The original one-block system has controlled energy exactly \(\|K^*f\|^2\).
The rank-one operator satisfies \(R(U)=R(K)\) and \(\|U^*f\|=\|K^*f\|\) for all \(f\).
The transformed image subspace is closed but \(KU^*P_{UW}=0\), so the transformed energy vanishes.
For closed-range \(K\), \((K^\dagger)^*K^*=P_{R(K)}\); the published proof's equality therefore requires \(R(U^*)\subseteq R(K)\).
Adding that adjoint-range condition recovers the printed pseudo-inverse lower-bound argument.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional matrix counterexample and a Moore--Penrose range calculation.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessary-and-sufficient replacement criterion beyond the theorem-specific repair is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The result refutes the sufficient direction of Theorem 2.3; the necessary direction remains valid.
The condition \(R(U^*)\subseteq R(K)\) is a sufficient repair and is not claimed necessary for every fixed frame.
For general bounded \(U\), closedness of each image subspace \(UW_i\) must also be ensured.
title: The adjoint-range gap in a controlled \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion transport criterion
